description: The colour pairs the theme is held to (WCAG 2.2: 4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for control outlines and the focus ring). Every key in foreground must reach min_ratio on every key in background, in each palette. Keys are the [branding.colors.<theme>] keys: x_y stands for the token --cb-x-y. Read by src/server/web/tests/contrast.test.ts (built-in palettes of tokens.css). The server's warnings for the operator's colours use CONTRAST_PAIRS in src/server/src/branding/colors.rs, a Rust constant that the test the_contrast_pairs_equal_the_shared_fixture keeps equal to this file.
